entries.definition: A flashing alarm emote used to flag breaking news or anything urgent; on election day 2026 it marked incoming results and announcements.
Signals alarm or draws attention. Part of the "conductor, we have a problem" meme.
Used for something based, or ironically for unhinged, racist, or sexist remarks. Embodies strength and confidence.
Appears to be the streamer IShowSpeed laughing hard; used when something is hilarious.
Variant of the Morgan Freeman "He's right you know" meme, used when someone says something correct.
The Mortal Kombat "Flawless Victory" call; used for a total, one-sided win, such as a race called by a big margin.
A face looking upward; chat uses it for anticipation or watching something rise.
A "bruh" face for exasperation: chat uses it when someone says or does something dumb or frustrating.
PEPE mixed with a turtle.
Appears to stand for "get snarked, nerd": posted after someone gets dunked on or corrected.
Combo emote used with NODDERS to reference rapping.
Originally a custom userscript, later a blocked phrase; used with the joke "bidness" and during suit depictions.
Kermit consoling Pepe the King Prawn.
An ironic or sincere "life is great" face; used to celebrate, and on election night 2026 for good news for chat's side.
An accusatory "I know what you are" reaction, calling someone out as secretly being something.
Lily Pichu's dog Temmie wearing a dunce cap; conveys naivete, stupidity, or ignorance, like guh.
Vegeta kneeling from Dragon Ball Z, used when calling people "Queen" or "King," sometimes ironically.
Used when someone is coping, in denial.
Expresses support or love for someone or when DGG is mentioned. Heart matches the poster's sub tier. Originally modeled after xQc's xqcL.
Signals nodding in response to a statement; one of two answers to being asked to come.
Used to point at something in chat, especially to mock; originated as a Halloween 2023 ApeHands reskin.
Expresses disbelief; originated from Black Gen Z creators and is referenced in discussions of AAVE.
Confused Joe Biden image, used when someone sounds senile or confused. Added after Biden's 2024 debate performance.
Absolute Cinema meme with Destiny's face, used for cinematic or extremely dramatic moments.
A dancing poro (the fluffy creature from League of Legends); a celebration emote, often spammed with other dancing emotes.
Used when schizophrenic opinions are expressed on stream or chatters feel like they're going crazy.
GIF of a pufferfish eating a carrot; used in any context, especially when someone is eating.
Altered MMMM with crossed arms; used when waiting for something.
A suspicious side-eye glance; used when something seems off or someone is being sketchy.
Appears to be a babbling or laughing face; chat posts it at something absurd or embarrassing.
Comfy-style MMMM, used to show arousal. Temporarily removed for excessive horny-posting.
A dancing alien GIF used for hype and celebration, often alongside other dancing emotes.
